## 2024-04-02 - [Fix] Fix XSS Vulnerability in History Render
**Vulnerability:** User generated content (`item.url`) from `localStorage` was interpolated directly into `div.innerHTML`. Because standard URL escaping (`encodeURIComponent`) used when generating the prompt didn't encode single quotes (`'`), it was still possible to break out of attributes or inject arbitrary tags by loading a malicious payload into `xhistory` in `localStorage`.
**Learning:** Even though URLs generated by the app were partially sanitized via `encodeURIComponent` before being sent to the Pollinations API, history loading could still inject unescaped content from `localStorage` directly into the DOM via `innerHTML`. When generating verification scripts involving JSON injection, quotes must be properly escaped by double-serializing the JSON string to correctly execute via `page.evaluate`.
**Prevention:** Always use DOM API methods (e.g., `document.createElement`, `.src = ...`, `.onclick = ...`) to build nodes when injecting user-controlled data rather than interpolating strings into `innerHTML`.
